title: Lab loops become sheets the game can draw
tier_reason: P-15 puts two loops into the game; nothing can be built until a loop exists as an asset the engine imports with its frame facts beside it.
ask: Under P-15 the game draws Animation Lab loops from their exported sheets as they are (no re-authoring in the engine). Build the export step: for a loop under tools/experiments/out/<slug>/, produce assets/anim/<slug>/ holding the sheet PNG and a manifest (JSON) with cell width, cell height, frame count, a frame rate, milliseconds per frame (read from the loop's GIF, never typed), the sky colour the loop was drawn on (the Lab's near-black, (33,31,32)), and an `edge` field that is `clean` when no non-sky pixel touches the left or right canvas edge in any frame and `dissolve` otherwise (the seeder's ground plane reaches its edge; the crow's and the bloom's do not) — all computed from the sheet and params.json, nothing typed by hand. Godot must import assets/anim/ (no .gdignore there) and must NOT import tools/experiments/out/ — it does today (the stray *.png.import files in git status prove it), so add a .gdignore to tools/experiments/out/. Export four loops: crow_gorge, seeder_bot, sunflower_bloom and watering_beam (Q-103 and Q-104 are ruled). Also write the bloom's first frame at ×5, unfiltered, as assets/anim/sunflower_bloom/splash.png for the engine's boot splash, on the sky colour, 800×600. Do not move or edit anything under tools/experiments/ or assets/showcase/ beyond the .gdignore; other sessions work there. Provenance for the loops in CREDITS.md is already filed as wcb7e529bc46 — do not duplicate it, but make sure the exported directory is covered by that entry's wording. Keep tools/check_gateway.py green and both suites green.
first_action: Read tools/experiments/out/crow_gorge/params.json and the sheet dimensions, and write the manifest shape from what is actually there.
source_message: Filed from the 2026-09-10 brainstorm on where the Animation Lab loops enter play (P-15, S-12).
